compliance.label: Single source authority stays on GitHub
compliance.details: currentSourceTruthV3 is displayed as authority; this site is a read-only derived snapshot.

compliance.label: camelHump identifiers and historical aliases preserved
compliance.details: No bulk renaming of projectHydra, projectPremonition, LuHm-OS or external protocol filenames.

compliance.label: No auto CAST, merge, deployment, signing or Crown
compliance.details: Browser controls only edit local triage state; no privileged side effects.

compliance.label: Source, CI, host and device receipts stay separate
compliance.details: Status labels cannot turn source configuration into runtime GREEN.

compliance.label: Original editable masters and human art direction respected
compliance.details: AI assists; Professor retains creative and approval authority.

compliance.label: Private archives remain in owner-controlled Drive
compliance.details: No archive bytes, private Drive IDs or signing material appear in this public site.

compliance.label: EVE / BodySlide / donor rights independently cleared
compliance.details: Private donor possession does not grant public redistribution.

compliance.label: No false autonomous agent execution claims
compliance.details: Role names and chat roleplay cannot stand in for host invocation receipts.

compliance.label: Static site has no shell or secret access
compliance.details: Godot and native authority behind a typed bridge only.

compliance.label: XMBI navigation has keyboard and touch paths
compliance.details: Control-room supports touch/swipe and keyboard; integration into native shell remains separate.

compliance.label: Plugin releases require checksums and acceptance
compliance.details: GitHub archive is not an installed ChatGPT plugin.

compliance.label: Rollback and backup defined before mutations
compliance.details: Small reversible commits on candidate branch, human review before merge.

auditStages.task: Resolve active source, scope, naming, ownership and baseline.
Inventory implementation evidence and highlight contradictions.
Review authorized assets, hashes, licenses and private lanes.
Make one scoped reversible change on candidate branch.
Run exact source unit, browser, Godot and negative tests.
Review patch, safety boundary and rollback on a PR.
Update evidence pointers and triage next gap.
Keep STOP until explicit host/release approval and verified receipts.
